name: Crescent Dart
description: Unleash Crescent Darts forward that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies.

stats.CASTING: Triple shot that fires in a straight trajectory
stats.FIRE RATE: 0.05s between shots - 0.57s between rounds of shooting
stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF:
Falloff begins at 30m, decreasing to 50% at 50m  
-20% per bounce

name: Hand of Khonshu
description: Open a portal that allows Khonshu to bombard enemies with his talons.

stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Begins at 1.5m from the center of the spell field, decreasing to 70% falloff at 5m

name: Moon Blade
description: Launch forward a Moon Blade that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies while granting you Bonus Health.

stats.CASTING: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory
stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF:
Falloff begins at 30m, decreasing to 50% at 50m 
-20% per bounce
stats.BONUS HEALTH: 25 per bounce, up to a max of 75

name: Ancient Ankh
description: Fire an Ankh to Knock enemies within its radius towards the center.

stats.CASTING: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

name: Moonlight Hook
description: Launch a frontal grappling hook that pulls Moon Knight towards it.

name: Triple Eclipse
description: Perform a combo with his truncheon, and the third strike will slightly Launch Up enemies.

name: Moon God's Chosen
description: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his Ancestral Sword in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.
